content: Magnesium salicylate is a widely used analgesic and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that is commonly employed to manage mild to moderate muscular pain. It is also indicated for the treatment of headaches, general back pain, and specific joint pain conditions such as arthritis. This compound is present in various over-the-counter (OTC) medications, primarily marketed for alleviating back pain due to its anti-inflammatory properties. Magnesium salicylate serves as an effective OTC alternative to prescription NSAIDs, offering both anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects. A typical dose of magnesium salicylate (4 mg anhydrous magnesium salicylate) can provide significant pain relief, even at half the recommended dosage, although the anti-inflammatory effects may be diminished at lower doses. Additionally, magnesium salicylate is an active ingredient in Pamprin, a medication formulated for the management of premenstrual syndrome (PMS) symptoms.
